﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: mina-core 2.1.5 鈫?2.2.1

## Context

Project `quickfixj` has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.apache.mina:mina-core` from `2.1.5` to `2.2.1`.

Reference PR: https://github.com/quickfix-j/quickfixj/pull/502

## Your Task

The source code is in `/quickfixj`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the compilation errors caused by the mina-core upgrade.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see compilation errors

All compilation errors have been fixed. Here's a summary of the changes made to fix the mina-core 2.1.5 → 2.2.1 upgrade:

## Changes Made

### 1. `SSLFilter.java`
- **Constructor** (line 45): Removed `autoStart` parameter from `super()` call since `SslFilter(SSLContext, boolean)` no longer exists in mina-core 2.2.1
- **PEER_ADDRESS constant** (line 43): Defined local constant `PEER_ADDRESS_KEY` since the parent class constant `PEER_ADDRESS` was removed
- **onPreAdd method** (line 71): Changed throws declaration from `SSLException` to `Exception` (API change in parent class)
- **Removed unused import**: `javax.net.ssl.SSLException`

### 2. `AbstractSocketAcceptor.java`
- **installSSL method** (line 135): Removed `setUseClientMode(false)` call - this method no longer exists. In mina-core 2.2.1, the client/server mode is determined by the `SSLContext` configuration

### 3. `IoSessionInitiator.java`
- **installSslFilter method** (line 191-202): Removed `autoStart` parameter from `SSLFilter` constructor and removed `setUseClientMode(true)` call

### 4. `InitiatorProxyIoHandler.java`
- **proxySessionOpened method** (line 62-65): Removed `initiateHandshake(ioSession)` call - in mina-core 2.2.1, SSL handshake is now started automatically when the session is created

`mvn compile` now succeeds with all 21 modules building successfully.
